target_customer: Developers, enterprises and consumers who need AI inference where even the provider cannot see prompts
problem: Using powerful cloud AI requires trusting providers with private data; on-prem does not scale and redaction or contracts are weak guarantees.
business_model: Usage-based API and containers plus a $20 per month consumer chat subscription

founders.name: Tanya Verma
founders.background_notes: YC page says she worked on Cloudflare's cryptography team and Workers AI.

founders.name: Jules Drean
education: MIT, PhD in secure hardware and confidential computing

founders.name: Sacha Servan-Schreiber
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder; the team page also lists a founding engineer.

technical_complexity.rationale: Attested inference on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell confidential compute with verifiable client-side checks needs deep hardware security and cryptography expertise that few teams have.

defensibility.rationale: Rare founder expertise and open attestation tooling help, but cloud providers and other confidential computing vendors can offer similar enclaves.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not found for Tinfoil. A peer, Opaque Systems, was acquired by Anthropic per a search summary dated 2026, which shows acquirers valuing the space.

market_need_then: Companies were blocked from sending private data to AI providers; Tinfoil's site lists customers such as DuckDuckGo and universities and claims SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance, all self-reported.

branding.domain_note: Uses tinfoil.sh, not a .com; a different company named Tinfoil Security exists.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Presents as a security research lab with a mission of a private garden for thought.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt and developer directory listings exist; no organic brand coverage found.

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable privacy-themed word, but no source confirms the intent, and there is name confusion with Tinfoil Security.

outcome_analysis: Tinfoil is active with a five-person team from Spring 2025, led by founders with cloud security and MIT secure hardware backgrounds, offering a chat app, inference API and containers. Funding is not verifiably known and no exit has occurred. The privacy-for-AI trend and customers like DuckDuckGo suggest early traction, but that comes from the company's own site.
notes: Conflicting funding reports: EveryDev $500K YC seed with Pioneer Fund, VCBacked $1.1M pre-seed in July 2024, StartupHub $501M (clearly an error). None verified, so no round recorded. Founder education for Verma comes from a YC profile snippet. The YC launch post names an additional co-founder Nate with no details; not listed as a founder. Competitor search returned undated vendor pages (Phala, Fortanix, Opaque, Anjuna, Duality), so the dated list is empty. Name origin not stated by any source. Completeness pass: VCBacked's 1.1M pre-seed announced 2024-07 is now recorded as a single-database round. EveryDev instead reports 500K seed from Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund (YC X25 batch), which conflicts, so the amount is uncertain. StartupHub's 501M is an error. A co-founder named Nate appears in sources with no confirmed full name, so none added.
